scope: Original create/list/Snapshot/command APIs with real PostgreSQL durable acceptance and scoped authorization. No workflow execution, workspace filesystem, artifact/device routes, UI integration or original AT completion.

original_contract_reconciliation.limit: Correct parent-plan default20 to original OpenAPI default25. Range1..100 unchanged. This explicit, dual-reviewed correction preserves the original contract; parent plan and original files stay byte-identical.
original_contract_reconciliation.detail: GET /jobs/{job_id} returns original Snapshot {job,steps,last_event_id}, not bare Job. In this pre-Temporal DRAFT-only increment, steps=[], last_event_id="" denotes no workflow events yet (not a fabricated event ID). Empty string is permitted by original schema. If row is not initial DRAFT/0/0/[]/null, fail503DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE rather than invent steps/events. B03/B04 must replace this narrow initial projection with persisted step/event projection before activation.
original_contract_reconciliation.outbox_mapping: Existing normalized storage is preserved without migration: conceptual scope=commands(project_id,job_id,actor_id,route); payload_hash=commands.payload_sha256; command status=commands.status; dispatch state=commands_outbox.state; expected_revision=literal0 for the fixed create route. Full immutable semantic payload is commands.command_payload_json. No create outbox consumer exists until B03.
original_contract_reconciliation.filters: Original route accepts only optional limit/cursor. Unknown or repeated query fields are422INVALID_REQUEST, including owner_id/project/status. Fixed effective filter is accessible jobs under active membership+owner/delegation. No user-selected owner filter exists. Cursor binds actor, fixed route and fixed scope.

request_boundary.create: Exact8 required original CreateJob fields, strict types/enums and no defaults/additional keys. application/json with optional charset=utf-8; no other content encoding than absent/identity. Reject duplicate Content-Type/Content-Encoding/Idempotency-Key. POST has no query. Authenticate session+Origin+CSRF before reading body or invoking bridge; final acceptance authenticates again after bridge.
request_boundary.size_and_depth: Stream cap8388608 bytes inclusive; cap exceeds ->422REQUEST_TOO_LARGE. Before JSON decode scan nesting outside quoted/escaped strings: top object depth1, arrays/objects maximum64 inclusive; excess ->same code. Strict UTF8/no BOM, duplicate JSON keys at any depth, nonfinite constants, nonobject, malformedJSON ->422INVALID_REQUEST. No raw body/profile is logged.
request_boundary.strings: Every CreateJob string is nonempty. All except request_text reject C0/DEL; request_text permits controls except NUL (newlines/tabs retained). title/base_ref/profile_version allow lone surrogates and astral values losslessly. project_id must be Unicode scalar. input_artifact_ids contains canonical lowercase UUID strings; preserve order and duplicates in semantic payload. Each ID must already identify an available artifact with same authenticated owner/project; missing/foreign/unavailable ->403FORBIDDEN, malformed identifier ->422INVALID_REQUEST. Upload remains deferred.
request_boundary.idempotency_header: Exactly one Idempotency-Key,1..128 printable ASCII including spaces; do not trim. Missing/duplicate/invalid ->422INVALID_REQUEST. No body or header may select owner,workflow,eligibility,paths orgrant.
request_boundary.semantic_identity: Persist json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),allow_nan=False) as ASCII TEXT, preserving every string/array value. Digest exactly SHA256(UTF8(json.dumps({"format":"ifpmic.create-job.v1","payload":payload},ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),allow_nan=False))). Different keys/samebody create independent jobs; object key order irrelevant; array order/string normalization affects identity.

authorization.create: Current verified session actor and active project membership with request.create. No caller identity headers trusted. Existing known membership is checked before any bridge request, then rechecked transactionally at acceptance.
authorization.reads: Repository SQL always scopes active membership AND (job.owner_id=actor OR unexpired/unrevoked action=job.read delegation for that same project/job/actor). Own reads require active membership but not request.create capability, which gates only new creation. Command reads use job scope; delegation grants only read, nevercreate/replay-as-other-actor.
authorization.existence: Missing/malformed/noncanonical/forbidden job/command detail IDs all403FORBIDDEN with fixed Error DTO. Lists hide inaccessible rows. UUID selectors never interpolate SQL. No RLS/productionauthorityclaim.

snapshot_binding.new_only: Use configured fixed SnapshotBridge.read_snapshot(project_id,profile_version). Result must be trusted SnapshotRecord and exactly match catalog project/version_key/snapshot_id/rawbytes/hash/ASCII label/mode/enabled/configuration_complete. Runtime cannot import or mutate catalog. workflow_version comes from record.workflow_id=ifpmic-sw-v1. Do not recompute Node version key/canonical hashes in Python.
snapshot_binding.eligibility: Under project guard require catalog enabled/configuration_complete, snapshot.mode==settings.mode, and matching unrevoked grant with granted_at<=trustednow<expires_at. Missing/knownineligible ->422PROFILE_INELIGIBLE; immutablecatalog/frame mismatch ->409PROFILE_VERSION_CONFLICT; child PROFILE_VERSION_INVALID ->422PROFILE_INELIGIBLE; other bridge/IO/protocol failures ->503DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE. A valid bridge record with no catalog row is known unprovisioned/ineligible.
snapshot_binding.config: Add optional paired settings node_executable/profile_store absolute path strings; malformed/unpaired ->SETTINGS_INVALID. When omitted auth/read/replay still operate; new creation requiring bridge ->503DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE. Default creates one lazy fixed bridge per app from these settings; injected bridge_runner must expose async read_snapshot. No request/env switch picks a bridge path.
snapshot_binding.replay: Before bridge/currenteligibility check, look up stable actor+fixedroute+key and recheck current membership and own resource. Originalmatchingdigest returns original202receipt regardless current file availability, eligibilityexpiry/revocation, removedcapability or missing bridgeconfig. Differentbody yields409 only after original resource authorization; inactive membership/foreignresource ->403. Do not turn accepted into applied.
snapshot_binding.bridge_failure_replay_probe: If preflight misses but Node capture fails, do one fresh authenticated scoped replay lookup before mapping the bridge failure. A concurrently committed winner is recovered without requiring its current file/eligibility. Probe miss keeps original bridge error mapping; no looping or second bridge launch.

transaction_and_races.isolation: Explicit READ COMMITTED, bounded lock_timeout5s/statement_timeout30s. Never await Node/network while holding an open transaction.
transaction_and_races.lock_order: Final transaction authenticate current session first, then lock relevant project authorization_guard FOR UPDATE, then membership FOR UPDATE NOWAIT. Guard lock and subsequent current authority reads are separate SQL statements. NOWAIT is mandatory: existing operator raw UPDATE locks membership before its BEFORE trigger waits guard; waiting for membership would deadlock. Lock contention55P03 returns503DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE with full rollback; no blind automatic retry. Caller may retry samekey. Membership and grant changes already serialize on guard triggers.
transaction_and_races.atomic_group: After snapshotcapture/finalauthorization/currenteligibility/artifact checks insert job ->command ->outbox ->workspaceintent in ONE transaction. DB generatesUUIDs; only permitted runtime columns inserted. Initialstate DRAFT/revision0/cycle0/[]/null, commandaccepted/applied_revisionnull/errornull, outboxpending,intentRESERVED. Session touch in same transaction. No filesystem effect.
transaction_and_races.unique_winner: Existing UNIQUE(actor_id,route,idempotency_key) is final arbiter. On only its exact UniqueViolation rollback the complete attempted group, then new authenticated transaction rechecks ORIGINAL command project/ownership/currentmembership and payloadhash. Other constraint errors ->503dependency. Same/different-session and cross-project key races must not leave orphanjobs.
transaction_and_races.replay_lock_scope: Existing command locks original project only. If it appears after locking requested-project authority, rollback through internal marker and perform fresh original-project replay; never acquire a second project or await bridge inside that transaction. No authorization decision is reused from an older preflight.
transaction_and_races.commit_uncertainty: Faults before commit preparation ->503DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE and zero newgroup. Set commit_started only immediately before transaction context commits. Any commit acknowledgment failure or fault after durablecommit/beforeHTTPresponse ->503COMMIT_UNCERTAIN; exactsamekeyretry discovers original receipt. Do not claim ambiguouscommit rolledback. ApiError validation/scope failures preserve their code.
transaction_and_races.fault_injection: Only injected Python fault_hook callable; no HTTP/environment faultflag. TC may launch separate Python test harness processes using factory+hook/barriers and actual Uvicorn. Independent race clients must use distinct valid sessions for sameactor because sessionFORUPDATE otherwise serializes.
transaction_and_races.fresh_clock: Read trusted auth.now() after authority locks for grant/delegation/session boundary decisions; reject expired session again if waiting crosses expiry.

pagination.query: GET /jobs onlylimit/cursor, default25,1..100; decimal ASCII digits canonical positive (no sign/leadingzero). Querymax16384bytes, strictpercent/UTF8/duplicatekeys. Reads/sessionrequired.
pagination.order: Descending (created_at,job_id), strict lexicographic < boundary. Fetchlimit+1 authorizedrows; next_cursor onlywhenmore exist. Compare authorization in same SQL that selects rows. Newer concurrent inserts before cursor are outside remainingpages; older inserts may appear aftercursor. No across-page snapshot isolation guarantee.
pagination.cursor: Canonical base64url-no-padding payload + "." + canonicalbase64urlHMACSHA256. Signing key=settings.csrf_key but domain ASCII("ifpmic.cursor.v1") || NUL byte || ASCII(base64url_payload) separate from CSRF. Payloadexact {v:1,actor_id,route:"GET /api/v1/jobs",scope:"accessible-jobs-v1",created_at:UTCiso8601microseconds,job_id:canonicalUUID}. VerifyMACconstanttime before parsing; strictJSON/canonicalencoding;max8192chars. No TTL: session/membership/delegation rechecked eachpage; provisionedkeyrotation invalidatescursor. Limit maychange acrosspages; no cursorcredentials/publication/logging.
pagination.errors: Malformed/tampered/wrongactor/wrongroute/wrongscope/invalidtimestamp/ID cursor ->422INVALID_REQUEST. Unknownowner/filterquery also422, not cursor-generatedpermission. No cursor includes inaccessible row identifiers; anchor comes onlyfrom lastvisibleitem.
